newsitem.title: USA: Cavco to build N.M. plant, create 300 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Cavco to build N.M. plant, create 300 jobs.

text.p: Cavco Industries Inc said it plans to build a manufacturing plan outside of Belen, N.M., creating about 300 to 350 jobs for the area.
The company said the new facility will manufacture both single-wide and double-wide homes designed to fit the needs of the New Mexico and Colorado markets.

Cavco said it plans to acquire about 23 acres near Belen where it will build the manufacturing plant. Construction is expected to begin in late September or early October, with an expected completion date of May 1997.

Cavco said the Belen plant will produce about 10 homes per day once full capacity is reached. The Belen facility will be Cavco's fourth manafacturing plant, with three others located in the Phoenix area.
Cavco is a producer of manufactured and modular homes, and mobile offices.
